series.name: FLA12100 LiFePO4 battery pack
series.notes: This is the FLA battery series Felicitysolar showcased at its first Pakistan product seminar, so it is high-relevance for the AC Ustad KB. The manual's 4.3 LED table documents 14 LED fault patterns C01-C14 but only C14 is tied to a named condition ('C14 Output loss') in the extractable text. The remaining C01-C13 patterns are recorded in NEGATIVE rather than guessed, because the manual does not state their meanings in a readable form. FAULT mode = red LED ON, green LED OFF, four SOC LEDs showing the code.

title.ur: Battery fault C14 Output kho gaya

meaning.en: The battery has lost its output. Check the breaker first, then the fuse.
meaning.ur: Battery ka output kho gaya hai. Pehle breaker check karein, phir fuse.

causes.ur: Battery ka circuit breaker khula hai

causes.en: Battery output relay or BMS contactor not closing
causes.ur: Battery output relay ya BMS contactor band nahi ho raha

solutions.en: Check whether the battery circuit breaker is closed and close it if open.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery ka circuit breaker band hai ya nahi, aur khula ho to band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check whether the pack fuse is normal; replace it with the exact rating if it is blown.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke pack ka fuse theek hai ya nahi; phoota ho to wahi rating ka lagayein.

solutions.en: Restart the unit; if the error happens again, return the pack to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Unit restart karein; error phir aaye to pack repair centre wapas bhejein.

codes.blinkPattern: FAULT mode - red LED ON, green LED OFF, SOC LED1 OFF, LED2 ON, LED3 ON, LED4 ON (steady)

notes.en: The manual's 4.4 fault table lists 10 more named conditions (Charge overcurrent, Discharge overcurrent, Cell overvoltage, Cell undervoltage, MOS overtemperature, MOS undertemperature, Cell over-temperature, Cell under-temperature, Abnormal output impedance, Abnormal current sampling) plus a 'Parallel failed' condition, but prints them without legible C-numbers, so they cannot be safely mapped to C01-C13. Do not assign them in the app from this document.
notes.ur: Manual ke 4.4 fault table mein 10 aur named conditions hain (Charge overcurrent, Discharge overcurrent, Cell overvoltage, Cell undervoltage, MOS overtemperature, MOS undertemperature, Cell over-temperature, Cell under-temperature, Abnormal output impedance, Abnormal current sampling) plus 'Parallel failed', lekin woh legible C-numbers ke baghair chhapa hain, is liye unhein C01-C13 par mehfooz tarah map nahi kiya ja sakta. Is document se app mein unhein assign na karein.
